* Serve as the organization's primary Workday expert and system owner, responsible for platform governance, optimization, and overall system health.
* Partner with business leaders to translate organizational needs into scalable Workday solutions and a long\-term roadmap.


**Business Process Optimization**
* Design, audit, and improve Workday business processes to enhance efficiency, automation, compliance, and user experience.
* Drive adoption of best practices and continuous improvement across the employee lifecycle.


**Security, Integrations \& Compliance**
* Own Workday security, access governance, integrations, and related vendor relationships.
* Ensure compliance, data integrity, system reliability, and resolution of complex security or integration issues.


**Reporting \& Analytics**
* Develop and maintain reports, dashboards, and workforce analytics that support operational and strategic decision\-making.
* Establish reporting standards and ensure data accuracy across the Workday environment.


**Release Management \& Documentation**
* Lead Workday releases, system enhancements, and adoption of new functionality.
* Maintain process documentation, SOPs, and cross\-training plans to support knowledge sharing and business continuity.


**Accountabilities/Results/Success For This Role**
* Strategic Platform Management
* System Reliability and Integration Performance
* Data Integrity, Security and Compliance
* Operational Efficiency and Stakeholder Satisfaction


**Required Qualifications/Skills/Competencies**
* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Information Systems, Business Administration, Computer Science, or a related field required.
* 10\+ years of progressive Workday administration and HRIS experience, including support of HCM, Talent, Recruiting, Security, Reporting, and Integrations.
* Proven success leading enterprise\-wide Workday implementations, optimizations, enhancements, and transformational initiatives.
* Experience supporting complex organizations with multi\-state and/or global operations.
* Expert knowledge of Workday HCM architecture, business processes, and system configuration.
* Advanced expertise in Workday Security, Reporting \& Analytics, Integrations, Release Management, Talent \& Recruiting, Organizational Structures, and Data Governance.
* Demonstrated ability to independently troubleshoot, analyze, and resolve complex system and business process challenges.
* Strategic mindset with the ability to align Workday capabilities and technology solutions to business objectives.
* Strong project management, prioritization, and organizational skills, with a track record of driving process improvements and governance initiatives.
* Exceptional communication, stakeholder management, and influencing skills, with the ability to lead change and build consensus across all levels of the organization.
* Workday certifications (preferred)


**What We Expect From Every Pinnacle Employee**
 Regardless of role, title, or tenure, you will be expected to:
   

  

* Take ownership of your work and outcomes
* Seek to understand before acting
* Contribute actively to solving challenges, not just identifying them
* Execute with discipline, quality, and reliability
* Communicate clearly to maintain alignment with teammates and customers
* Demonstrate integrity, accountability, and respect in all interactions
* Continuously learn, improve, and grow — personally and professionally


**What This Environment Is Not**
 Pinnacle may not be the right fit if you:
   

  

* Prefer rigid structure with narrowly defined responsibilities
* Avoid accountability, feedback, or ownership of outcomes
* Expect problems to be solved for you rather than with you
* Are uncomfortable operating in dynamic, evolving environments
* Prioritize personal recognition over team success


 We believe clarity works both ways. Our goal is long\-term mutual success — not just filling roles.
   

  

**Benefits**

**Working Environment**

Working closely with others or working alone. Working extended or irregular hours and travelling by all possible modes of transportation.


**Physical Job Requirements**

title: Senior C# Architect
description:
**About the company:** 




 Our client is a wellness technology company dedicated to helping organizations build healthier, more engaged, and productive workplaces. It offers customizable employee wellness programs that align with organizational culture, values, and business goals.
 



 The company combines fitness technology, mobile applications, web\-based tools, health content, and wellness services such as fitness classes, webinars, and health coaching. Its platform enables employees to track healthy habits, participate in wellness activities, earn rewards, and engage in friendly challenges, helping organizations foster a strong culture of health and well\-being.
 



  





**About the Role:** 




 We're looking for a Senior C\# Architect to own the technical architecture of our core platform, spanning legacy ASP.NET MVC/Web API services and modern cloud\-native systems. You'll balance hands\-on coding with high\-level design, guide a team of engineers, and drive decisions on scalability, performance, and modernization including migration paths from .NET Framework to .NET 8\+.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Own end\-to\-end architecture for ASP.NET MVC and Web API applications, including API design, service boundaries, and data access patterns
* Lead technical design reviews and set coding/architecture standards across teams
* Drive cloud infrastructure decisions (AWS) compute, networking, storage, caching, and managed database services
* Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks in production systems (SQL Server, IIS, connection pooling, caching layers)
* Design and implement caching strategies (Redis/ElastiCache) to decouple read\-heavy workloads from primary databases
* Guide migration strategy from ASP.NET Framework (4\.x) to .NET Core/.NET 8\+, including hosting model changes (IIS to containerized/cloud\-native)
* Architect for high availability, disaster recovery, and horizontal scalability
* Mentor senior/mid\-level engineers on system design and code quality
* Collaborate with product and infra teams to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions
* Own technical documentation, RFCs, and architecture decision records (ADRs)
* Participate in incident response and root\-cause analysis for critical production issues



  





**Required Qualifications:** 



* Deep expertise in C\#, ASP.NET MVC, ASP.NET Web API (both .NET Framework and .NET Core/.NET 8\+)
* Strong background in RESTful API design, versioning, and security (OAuth2/JWT)
* Proven experience architecting solutions on AWS (EC2, RDS, ElastiCache, Lambda, S3\) equivalents
* Solid SQL Server expertise: query optimization, indexing strategy, execution plan analysis, stored procedures
* Experience with distributed caching (Redis) and message queuing (SQS, RabbitMQ)
* Strong understanding of IIS configuration, application pools, and Windows Server hosting environments
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker), and infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform/CloudFormation)
* Track record of leading legacy modernization/migration projects
* Excellent communication skills able to explain architecture tradeoffs to both engineers and business stakeholders



  





**Preferred Qualifications:** 



* Experience with microservices architecture and event\-driven design
* Familiarity with Entity Framework/EF Core and ORM performance tuning
* Exposure to mobile backend architecture (APNs, push notification systems, mobile API design)
* Experience in health/wellness, fintech, or other regulated/data\-sensitive industries
* AWS/Azure architecture certification



  





**What Success Looks Like:** 



* Reduced latency and improved scalability on high\-traffic APIs
* Clear technical roadmap for legacy\-to\-cloud\-native migration
* Fewer production incidents tied to architecture\-level issues (connection pooling, caching gaps, DB contention)
* Mentored engineers taking on more architecture ownership over time

description:
Your Team Responsibilities
   

  

 At MSCI, data is at the core of everything we do. We are looking for a Associate Oracle Database Administrator (DBA) to support and modernize our mission\-critical enterprise databases that power global financial products and analytics.
   

  

 This role requires deep expertise in Oracle DBA administration, performance tuning, high availability, disaster recovery, OCI Cloud, large\-scale project implementations, migrations, upgrades, and modernization initiatives and strong ownership of database operations, with readiness to support cloud and AI\-driven transformation initiatives.
   

  

 Your Key Responsibilities
   

  

**Database Administration \& Operations**
* Perform end\-to\-end Oracle DBA administration including installation, configuration, upgrades, patching, and decommissioning.
* Manage production, non\-production, and DR environments with high availability and performance.
* Handle database operations, monitoring, and 24x7 operational support as required.
* Ensure database security, compliance, and best practices.


**Performance Tuning \& Troubleshooting**
* Perform advanced performance tuning using AWR, ASH, SQL Trace, and OEM.
* Analyze execution plans, identify bottlenecks, and implement plan stability techniques.
* Develop and maintain performance tuning scripts and automation.
* Proactively troubleshoot database issues and provide root cause analysis (RCA).


**High Availability \& Disaster Recovery**
* Design, implement, and support Oracle Data Guard (Physical \& Logical Standby).
* Perform switchover/failover operations and DR drills.
* Manage RMAN backups, recovery, and restore strategies.
* Ensure RPO/RTO compliance and DR readiness.


**Cloud \& Modernization**
* Administer Oracle databases on OCI or Azure (Cloud Infrastructure)
* Support on\-prem to cloud migrations, hybrid environments, and cloud\-native architectures.


**Security \& Advanced Features**
* Implement and manage Transparent Data Encryption (TDE).
* Utilize Advanced Compression and other Oracle features for performance and storage optimization.
* Apply database security patches and vulnerability remediation.


**Project Implementation \& Migration**
* Support database projects including:
+ New database implementations
+ Version upgrades
+ Platform migrations
+ Consolidation initiatives

* Work closely with application teams, infrastructure, and cloud teams during project execution.
* Provide technical documentation and knowledge transfer.


**Technical Skills**
 Your skills and experience that will help you excel
   

  

* Strong expertise in Oracle Database Administration (19c and above).
* Hands\-on experience with:
+ Performance tuning (AWR, ASH, SQL tuning)
+ Oracle Data Guard \& Standby
+ RMAN backup and recovery
+ Database migration and upgrades

* Basic experience in scripting (Shell, SQL, PL/SQL) for automation and monitoring.
* Strong knowledge of patching strategies and lifecycle management.


**Soft Skills**
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management.
* Ability to lead critical incidents and mentor junior DBAs.
* Proactive mindset with a focus on continuous improvement.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Oracle Certifications (OCA / OCP / Cloud Certification).
* Experience in regulated or large enterprise environments.


**About MSCI**
**What we offer you**
* Transparent compensation schemes and comprehensive employee benefits, tailored to your location, ensuring your financial security, health, and overall wellbeing.
* Flexible working arrangements, advanced technology, and collaborative workspaces.
* A culture of high performance and innovation where we experiment with new ideas and take responsibility for achieving results.
* A global network of talented colleagues, who inspire, support, and share their expertise to innovate and deliver for our clients.
* Global Orientation program to kickstart your journey, followed by access to our Learning@MSCI platform, AI Learning Center , LinkedIn Learning Pro and tailored learning opportunities for ongoing skills development.

Database Administrator
description:
**Summary**
 We are seeking a skilled and motivated SQL Database Administrator to join our 24x7 operations team. In this role, you will be responsible for the health, performance, and availability of our critical SQL Server databases, with a strong emphasis on Always On Availability Groups (AG) and High Availability/Disaster Recovery (HADR) solutions. You will be part of a team ensuring our databases are running optimally and that we can quickly recover from any unforeseen issues.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Administer and maintain SQL Server databases on Azure, ensuring optimal performance, security, and availability.
* Implement, configure, and manage AlwaysOn Availability Groups (AG) for high availability and disaster recovery.
* Troubleshoot and resolve database performance issues, outages, and other incidents in a timely manner.
* Participate in a 24x7 on\-call rotation, responding to alerts and incidents as needed.
* Collaborate with development, infrastructure, and other teams to ensure database solutions meet business requirements.
* Develop and maintain documentation for database configurations, procedures, and troubleshooting steps.
* Implement and maintain database security measures, including user access controls and data encryption.
* Perform database backups and restores.
* Monitor database performance and proactively identify potential issues.
* Apply database patches and upgrades.
* Participate in capacity planning and performance tuning activities.


**Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of experience as a SQL Server Database Administrator.
* AZ\-900 certification would be added advantage
* Hands\-on experience with Always On Availability Groups (AG) or other High Availability/Disaster Recovery (HADR) solutions.
* Strong hands\-on experience with SQL Server database administration, including installation, configuration, maintenance, and troubleshooting.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively communicate technical information to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced, 24x7 environment.
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Experience with database monitoring tools (SentryOne/LogicMonitor/AppDynamics).
* Experience with SQL Server performance tuning.
* Experience with database security best practices.

The ideal candidate should possess good experience in SQL Server administration, database development, SSRS reporting, replication management, and basic cloud database migration and maintenance capabilities.
   

  

****Key Responsibilities****
 Database Administration
   

  

* Administer, monitor, maintain, and optimize Microsoft SQL Server databases.
* Ensure database availability, performance, security, and reliability.
* Perform database backup, restore, recovery, and disaster recovery planning.
* Manage database configurations, maintenance plans, and SQL Server Agent jobs.
* Monitor database health and troubleshoot performance bottlenecks.


**Database Development**
* Design, develop, and maintain:
+ Stored Procedures
+ Functions
+ Views
+ Tables
+ Indexes
+ Triggers

* Optimize SQL queries and database objects for performance and scalability.
* Support database schema changes and application deployments.


**Reporting Services (SSRS)**
* Develop, maintain, and enhance SSRS reports.
* Design dashboards and operational reports based on business requirements.


**Replication Management**
* Configure, monitor, and troubleshoot SQL Server replication environments.
* Manage transactional, merge, and snapshot replication jobs.
* Ensure data synchronization and replication health across environments.


**Cloud Knowledge**
* Support database migration activities to cloud platforms (Azure/AWS).
* Maintain cloud\-hosted SQL databases and monitor performance.
* Assist in planning and implementing cloud database backup, recovery, and security strategies.
* Familiarity with Azure/AWS in application development related services is an added advantage. Candidates should be eager to learn and implement cloud technologies.


****Technical Skills****
**Required Skills \& Experience**
* Good experience with Microsoft SQL Server (2016/2019/2022 or later).
* Expertise in:
+ T\-SQL Programming
+ Stored Procedures
+ Functions
+ Views
+ Indexing Strategies
+ Query Optimization

* Experience managing SQL Server Agent Jobs and Maintenance Plans.
* Hands\-on experience with SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS).
* Experience with SQL Server Replication setup and support.
* Knowledge of database security, user management, and access control.
* Familiarity with backup/recovery and disaster recovery procedures.


****Cloud Skills****
* Basic knowledge of database services such as Azure Managed database Instance / AWS RDS for SQL Server
* Familiarity with Azure/AWS services is an added advantage. Candidates should be eager to learn and implement cloud technologies in application development.


****Experience****
* Experience in SQL Server Administration and Development.
* Experience supporting production\-critical database environments.


**Key Competencies**
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
* Good communication and stakeholder management skills.


 Ability to work independently and within cross\-functional teams.
